name: Old Babylonian Mesopotamia — documented knowledge and explanatory practices
methodology_note: This panel records practices directly attested in Old Babylonian or securely early-second-millennium sources. Empty 'unknown' and 'natural explanation' arrays mean this first research pass has not yet added a sufficiently sourced atomic claim in those categories; they do not mean Old Babylonian people knew nothing else or lacked naturalistic reasoning. Evidence is heavily biased toward literate institutions and surviving tablets.
notes: Do not generalize scribal, mathematical, legal, medical, or divinatory specialist knowledge to every person in Old Babylonian Mesopotamia.
